definitions.explanation: Supernatural power to make impossible things happen. Used for both fictional magic and figuratively for something seemingly miraculous.

examples.japanese: {魔法|まほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頃|ころ}、{魔法|まほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えたら→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧な⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}っていた→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: When I was a child, I wished I could use magic.

examples.japanese: ⟦まるで→まるで：03739_marude⟧{魔法|まほう}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧⟦{痛|いた}み→痛み：01795_itami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えた→消える：02520_kieru⟧。
examples.english: The pain disappeared as if by magic.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {魔法|まほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (cast a spell)
- {魔法|まほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{解|と}ける→解ける：04371_tokeru⟧ (a spell is broken)
- {魔法|まほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧ (use magic)
- {魔法|まほう}⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧ (as if by magic)

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{魔法使|まほうつか}い→魔法使い：15532_mahoutsukai⟧ (magician, wizard)
- {魔法|まほう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{杖|つえ}→杖：12862_tsue⟧ (magic wand)
- ⟦{魔法瓶|まほうびん}→魔法瓶：17387_mahoubin⟧ (thermos — literally "magic bottle")

Often appears in fantasy fiction and fairy tales. ⟦{魔法瓶|まほうびん}→魔法瓶：17387_mahoubin⟧ (thermos) is a notable everyday compound that uses this word.
